terminalDestination.fogExemption: Oculus interior and four emissive stone rims only; ordinary depth testing retained.
terminalDestination.framing: Opening unobstructed right of desktop title and above mobile title; global water fog, lighting, exposure and reading shades unchanged.

motion.name: camera-follow
motion.purpose: Smooth scroll depth journey; disabled under reduced motion.

shadows.name: submerged-vignette
shadows.purpose: Darkens viewport edges without card elevation.

reading.grammar: Open shafts, fine jade vertical rules, amber heading inlays, descending inscription columns. No panels or glass cards.
reading.controls: Header and atmosphere button at threshold only; scroll away with opening
reading.camera: Chapter offset interpolation 0/.25/.5/.75/1; original camera path and geometry preserved

components.name: Atmosphere button
components.description: Threshold-only 44px control; pause ambient effects while scroll camera stays usable.

components.name: Chapter navigation
components.description: Direct access to content without completing the scene.

components.name: Contact route
components.description: Real LinkedIn route with an authored arrow.
components.html: Connect on LinkedIn

narrative.overview: Submerged architectural depth carries the site. Fluted jade piers and segmented marble arches establish a physical scale; ordinary scrolling provides the journey, while HTML remains the readable layer. The water palette is committed at page scale, not confined to accents.
keyCharacteristics: Dark teal negative space and warm contact light.
Inscription hierarchy and open architectural reading columns, without cards.

rules.name: The Water Rule
rules.body: Readable dark water remains beneath text; scenery is not a license to erase contrast.

rules.name: The Stationary Rule
rules.body: Reduced motion preserves a rendered architecture at the starting camera, disables ambient motion and removes scroll-camera movement; all sections remain direct.

dos: Do keep professional content in the HTML reading layer.
Do carry architectural depth through actual geometry and lighting.
Do use direct native anchors and visible focus treatment.
donts: Don't require scene exploration to reach contact.
Don't convert this into a dashboard, card grid or game.
Don't imply the architectural fiction is a client project or outcome.
